title: AnchorCatalog
description: Anchor catalog SSOT (Plan 3.9.0). Named lifecycle moments with typed Envelopes. Catalog files under lycaon/config/runtime/anchors/ validate against this schema. Emit uses catalog-validated ids (MustAnchor / string + contract) — no Kick*-shaped parallel enum and no anchors codegen.

schema_version.description: Catalog document version (MAJOR.MINOR). Bump minor for additive anchors; major for id renames/removals.

id.description: Stable dotted lifecycle-moment id (e.g. leg.finished, tool.pre_invoke, gate.blocked). Never a Kick* const or provisional OAR stage enum.

title.description: Short human label for docs and authoring UIs.

description.description: When this moment fires (machine-state terms only).

dedup.description: Default dedup/suppression policy for Bindings on this anchor. Subsumes SignalEvent + ComputeSignalSuppression.

planes.description: Which Binding effect planes attach here. Default both when omitted.

triggerClass.description: Unified closed taxonomy folding kicks/_contract.yaml trigger_class and OAR coarse lifecycle buckets (formerly provisional stage aliases).

envelope.description: Typed render/fact vars this anchor guarantees in scope when Emit fires. Formalizes what buildKickRenderData / mergeKickPolicyVars produced ad hoc.

vars.description: Map of var name → type declaration. Templates and CEL when: may only reference declared vars (plus the shared OAR fact set for block Bindings).

type.description: Host-assembled type. object/object[] are structured DTOs (e.g. gate_obligations rows).

required.description: When true, Emit must supply the var (fail closed if missing).

dedup.description: Suppression policy when this anchor's inform Binding fires. Replaces SignalEvent rows.

key.description: Stable dedup channel id (was SignalEvent string).

omit_hint_codes.description: Hint codes to suppress when an inform Binding on this anchor is queued.

omit_inform_when.description: Conditions under which inform render is omitted (was SignalBoardReinjected / SignalLoopWake omit_kick).
